name: Discount line
description: Promotional discount applied to the fare or a specific service. Negative monetary impact — aggregated separately from positive surcharges/taxes.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Discount value in pointOfSale currency. Stored positive — engine flips the sign at totalisation time.

fields.name: appliesTo
fields.description: What the discount is reducing — "fare", "bag", "meal", … . Defaults to fare.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Human-readable note shown alongside the rule's verdict (e.g. "destination in eligible market").
